1-3y.question: Where is institutional capital moving in the immediate and medium term?
1-3y.method: Recent money only: FPI net equity flows over the last 6 fortnights (as % of FPI holdings in the sector), quarter-on-quarter change in institutional shareholding (median company), breadth (share of companies where institutions raised their stake), non-trading institutional net buying in bulk/block deals over 90 days, new independent >1% holders, bank credit growth since March, and fund-house breadth: across mutual fund houses' active schemes, how many stock positions in the sector were added to or opened vs trimmed or closed in the latest monthly portfolio files (index funds, ETFs and arbitrage funds excluded). Each component is a percentile rank across sectors.

3-10y.question: Which industries attract long-duration capital?
3-10y.method: Persistence and commitment: share of the last 36 months with positive FPI flows, 12-month FPI flow, year-on-year institutional shareholding change, bank credit YoY (RBI SIBC), growth in cumulative AIF investment by sector (SEBI), and corporate capital events filed with NSE (acquisitions, capex, JVs, QIPs) in 180 days.
3-10y.not_used: Single-quarter swings; announced amounts are not added to deployed money.

10-20y.question: Where is capital positioning for structural change?
10-20y.method: No forecasts. Themes are ranked by how many independent official indicators currently point the same way (World Bank structural series over 10 years, bank credit, AIF investment, FPI flows since 2017, Cabinet approvals). Each theme is a SCENARIO with explicit confirm and invalidate conditions.
10-20y.not_used: Extrapolated growth rates, market-size estimates, company names.
